title: 📊 Daily Report: Tue Nov 3, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $18,349.81. This week it's down $250.00 against Monday's base: the strategy bots are -$51.87 (still in deficit) and the CORE QQQ position is -$198.13. Since the merge the book is -8.35% (-$1,670.93), while Indy, the SPY benchmark, is -3.11% (-$622.87), so we trail it by $1,048.06.

Only Trek traded today, at half size because of the JOLTS report and the midterm election. It stopped out of COP for -$15.15 and bought a breakout in VRSN at $314.06. Rota and Sunny were active but made no trades. CORE QQQ is $14,903 (81% of the book) with the trend filter ON (prior close 681.09 vs 200-day 678.68). Idle cash earned +$0.24 in interest.

Research's analyst note (Nov 3):
- AI stocks led a rebound: Nasdaq +0.8%, S&P +0.35%, Dow -0.4%, though most S&P stocks fell. MSFT +3%, AMZN +2.7%, and NVDA +2.4% bounced after four down days.
- Apple dragged after warning about memory costs and stays on the avoid list along with PLTR.
- DD's beat-and-raise idea worked, closing +8.4% at $153.22. Non-tech beat-and-raises are still the best setup.
- Steer clear of earnings losers SHOP, SYY, IT, ADM, and ZBRA.
- Coming up: midterm results tonight, AMD/ANET/SMCI after hours, ADP and ISM Services on Wednesday, and October jobs on Friday.

Floor: https://blackk92.github.io/tendies-and-dip/

Mascot joke from Salmon (not a trader): Only Tesla and SpaceX!
